lines.text: Paul says he will not be mastered by anything, and that the body is for the Lord.
By His power God raised the Lord from the dead, and He will raise us also.
Paul says our bodies are members of Christ, and quotes Scripture that the two will become one flesh.
Paul says the one united with the Lord is one with Him in soul, and commands believers to flee sexual immorality.
Paul says your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, and you were bought with silver, so glorify God.
